data: Tesla's fiscal 2024 results showed a business holding its top line while profitability compressed. Revenue rose 0.9% to $97.7 billion in fiscal 2024 from $96.8 billion in fiscal 2023. Gross profit slipped to $17.4 billion from $17.7 billion, leaving a fiscal 2024 gross margin of 17.9%. Operating income fell to $7.1 billion in fiscal 2024 from $8.9 billion in fiscal 2023, for an operating margin of 7.2%, while R&D expense climbed to $4.5 billion from $4.0 billion. The bottom line weakened more sharply. Net income declined 52.7% to $7.1 billion in fiscal 2024 from $15.0 billion in fiscal 2023, and diluted EPS fell to $2.04 per share from $4.30. We see the continued R&D spending as strategically sound, but a return to earnings growth likely depends on stabilizing margins.
